name: Compiled Per-Ray Triangle Grid Walk
definition: A ray traversal method that walks a triangle grid using a compiled loop (Numba) with one iteration per ray, replacing the previous array-based approach that used whole-array numpy passes over every ray still in flight.
summary: Compiled Per-Ray Triangle Grid Walk is a ray traversal method that uses a compiled Numba loop to process each ray individually, eliminating the overhead of global state arrays used in previous approaches.
